text:
Jonathan Lekkerimäki is the bright spot in a hard Canucks season. The 22-year-old Swede, Vancouver's 15th pick in 2022, has 18 points in 26 games, already double his career total before this year, and 11 of them on the power play. Among forwards picked 10th to 20th since 2005, the typical first full season produces 0.35 points a game. He's at 0.69.

The shot is the reason. Daily Hive wrote about the technique behind it, and his hardest shot this season (88 mph) ranks in the 84th percentile. He's scoring a little above his chances (7 goals on 5.43 expected), which is the sort of edge a pure shooter can keep.

The caution is at even strength. Vancouver gets only 39% of the expected goals at 5-on-5 with him on the ice, though that's no worse than the team without him. His last ten games brought 5 points, a slight dip. If the power play keeps humming, our range puts him between 43 and 65 points.
